title: SecOps-NG CRA Article 14 Timing Milestone
description: Identifies which milestone on the CRA Article 14 regulator-notification chain a disclosure-timeline event records. Promoted out of the F-WF-01 regulator-notification chain (which declared the four milestones in prose on its sub-steps) so the vulns evidence stream's `disclosure_timeline[]` records and the four CRA-timing KPIs share one vocabulary. Each milestone names the clock-start it is measured against in the KPI catalog entries.

x_milestone_definitions.early_warning_24h: CRA Article 14(1) early warning, due within 24h of operator awareness of an actively-exploited vulnerability. Consumed by `kpi.cra_early_warning_on_time@v1`.
x_milestone_definitions.severe_incident_24h: CRA Article 14(3) severe-incident notification, due within 24h of awareness of a severe incident impacting product security. Consumed by `kpi.cra_severe_incident_on_time@v1`.
x_milestone_definitions.incident_notification_72h: CRA Article 14(1) incident notification, due within 72h of operator awareness. Consumed by `kpi.cra_notification_72h_on_time@v1`.
x_milestone_definitions.final_report_14d: CRA Article 14(1) final report, due within 14 days of remediation or mitigation availability. Consumed by `kpi.cra_final_report_on_time@v1`.
